items.title: I’m so thrilled to announce that we’re bringing our Cardboard Wars Film and other new stories to Disney! I fell in love with filmmaking and storytelling as a young kid, grabbing my parents’ home video camera and teaching myself to edit. A lot of my early homemade films were inspired by the Disney movies and the behind-the-scenes footage they would show in the DVD featurettes. There was always a sense of magic I would see on the screen, and so I’m thrilled to be working with Disney to continue that magic of filmmaking for the next generation of storytellers.

items.title: Both of these tricks have no Visual Effects in them. No editing. It’s a practical gag that was done by Buster Keaton over 100 years ago in 1924. My team and I recreated it using no VFX as well to figure out how it was done, and it made me appreciate his work so much more! #behindthescenes

items.title: I can’t take credit for all the amazing things my team is able to pull off. This video concept was to visualize the inside of a laundry machine and battle an octopus style laundry monster. The art department was able to pull off some incredible magic on this one, even building a full size laundry monster that took 4 people to operate from the inside. Grateful for all the people who help us pull off these fun and ambitious videos! #behindthescenes
